description: Resize an artboard to the bounds of the given artwork (Object > Artboards > Fit to Selected Art), or without target, to all the artwork on it (Fit to Artwork Bounds)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

target.description: Fit to these items. Default: all the artwork on the artboard

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: fit_artboard_to_artwork
title: Fit Artboard To Artwork
